changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: Crea la tabla assessment_attempts: intentos de quiz por tema, evaluación final y prueba de retención, con estado e ítems del intento. Incluye secuencia propia, tabla de auditoría assessment_attempts_audit y el trigger assessment_attempts_audit_trg.

createTable.remarks: Attempts of topic quizzes, final and retention assessments

column.name: id
column.remarks: Primary key

column.name: public_id
column.remarks: Public identifier exposed by the API instead of the sequential id

column.name: enrollment_id
column.remarks: Enrollment that takes the assessment

column.name: path_step_id
column.remarks: Path step evaluated; null in final and retention assessments

column.name: assessment_type
column.remarks: Assessment type: topic, final or retention

column.name: attempt_number
column.remarks: Attempt number, starting at 1

column.name: status
column.remarks: Attempt status: created, in_progress, submitted, grading, graded or grading_failed

column.name: item_ids
column.remarks: Ids of the assessment items of the attempt, as a JSON array

column.name: uses_extra_grant
column.remarks: Whether the attempt consumes an extra attempt grant

column.name: score
column.remarks: Score obtained as percentage

column.name: passed
column.remarks: Whether the attempt reached the approval threshold

column.name: submitted_at
column.remarks: Moment the attempt was submitted

column.name: graded_at
column.remarks: Moment the attempt was graded

column.name: active
column.remarks: Logical state: false means deactivated (rows are never deleted)

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Creation timestamp

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last update timestamp, maintained by the set_updated_at trigger

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE assessment_attempts ADD CONSTRAINT assessment_attempts_type_ck CHECK (assessment_type IN ('topic', 'final', 'retention'))

ALTER TABLE assessment_attempts ADD CONSTRAINT assessment_attempts_step_ck CHECK ((assessment_type = 'topic' AND path_step_id IS NOT NULL) OR (assessment_type IN ('final', 'retention') AND path_step_id IS NULL))
ALTER TABLE assessment_attempts ADD CONSTRAINT assessment_attempts_number_ck CHECK (attempt_number >= 1)
ALTER TABLE assessment_attempts ADD CONSTRAINT assessment_attempts_status_ck CHECK (status IN ('created', 'in_progress', 'submitted', 'grading', 'graded', 'grading_failed'))
ALTER TABLE assessment_attempts ADD CONSTRAINT assessment_attempts_item_ids_ck CHECK (jsonb_typeof(item_ids) = 'array')
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX assessment_attempts_number_uq ON assessment_attempts (enrollment_id, assessment_type, COALESCE(path_step_id, 0), attempt_number)
CREATE TRIGGER assessment_attempts_set_updated_at_trg BEFORE UPDATE ON assessment_attempts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

column.name: audit_id
column.remarks: Primary key of the audit row

column.name: record_id
column.remarks: Id of the audited row in assessment_attempts

column.name: operation
column.remarks: INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE

column.name: old_data
column.remarks: Row before the change

column.name: new_data
column.remarks: Row after the change

column.name: changed_at
column.remarks: Moment of the change

column.name: db_user
column.remarks: Database user that made the change

column.name: app_user_id
column.remarks: Application user that made the change (smartmentor.current_user_id)

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE assessment_attempts_audit ADD CONSTRAINT assessment_attempts_audit_operation_ck CHECK (operation IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE'))
CREATE TRIGGER assessment_attempts_audit_trg AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON assessment_attempts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_row_change()

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS assessment_attempts_audit_trg ON assessment_attempts
